criteria.RC1_bias: |mean(w_hat) - w_true| <= 0.10 * a for w_on and w_off, in every CORE scenario
criteria.RC2_coverage: 95% Wald CI coverage for w_on and w_off within [0.90, 0.98], in every CORE scenario
criteria.RC4_onset_vs_midpoint: P(angle CI excludes 45 deg | onset truth, moderate) >= 0.80 AND P(angle CI excludes 0 deg | midpoint truth, moderate) >= 0.80
criteria.RC5_null_false_interpretation: P(joint Wald test of (w_on, w_off) = 0 rejects at 0.05 | guessing) <= 0.07
criteria.decision_rule: An allocation PASSES recovery only if RC1-RC5 all hold. The smallest passing allocation within the 30-minute condition-A burden limit is recommended. Low-sensitivity, lapse-heavy and heterogeneity scenarios are reported but are not pass/fail criteria.
